probe_detail.name: Answers the question that was actually asked
Generalizes the method beyond the specific numbers

final.name: Bounded personal question answered in the asker's register
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the question is bounded/personal versus broad/scholarly and whether the answer's register matches that scope, which is a topic-scope and audience-register marker rather than a direct measure of the answer's substance.
final.arbiter_reason: Half of the composite scores a property of the QUESTION (bounded/personal vs broad/scholarly), which is a topic-scope marker about the stimulus rather than evidence about the answer that is the item, and the register half only asks whether the pitch matches that scope. A high score therefore certifies the kind of exchange this is, not the substance of the answer; routed mixed because bounded prompts do plausibly admit genuinely complete, exactly-right answers.

final.name: Visible revision markers
final.audit_justification: Counts surface revision markers like 'EDIT' without judging whether the editing improved the content, a textual fingerprint of the production process.

final.name: Sheer bulk and display-mathematics density
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores volume of text and display-math blocks alone and instructs not to judge whether the length is warranted, i.e. pure verbosity/bulk.

final.name: Author personality / conversational asides
final.audit_justification: Rates informal/conversational personal voice and jokes, a stylistic and personality marker rather than evidence about the content.

final.name: Notation and logical discipline
final.audit_justification: Directly assesses whether notation and logic remain valid and unambiguous, which is evidence about the correctness of the mathematical content.

final.name: External-resource citation and tool appeals
final.audit_justification: Scores the extent of outward pointing (links, citations, tool namedrops) while explicitly excluding whether those citations are authoritative or relevant, a citation-habit/formatting marker.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's access to and practice with external resources and literature (academic affiliation, tooling habits)

final.name: Reproducible next steps
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the answer actually gives an executable, ordered path to the result, which is direct evidence of the answer's substantive completeness.

final.name: Edge-case coverage
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the answer correctly handles edge cases and boundary behavior, direct evidence of mathematical correctness/completeness.

final.name: Hint register and deliberate incompleteness
final.audit_justification: Scores the extent of hint-style versus fully-worked register while explicitly excluding judgment of whether the hint is good, correct, or pedagogically warranted -- a register marker.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's practice with site homework-policy conventions (a regular who knows the norm of hinting rather than solving)

final.name: Named participants, @handles and priority acknowledgements
final.audit_justification: Counts named participants, @handles, and credit language while explicitly excluding whether the credit is deserved, a social/community-style marker.
final.upstream_parent: the answerer's social embedding in the site community (recognising and being recognised by other regulars)

final.name: Second-person address with an executable next step
final.audit_justification: The scale is anchored primarily on second-person address style (impersonal third-person vs sustained direct address), a register marker, with actionability only distinguishing the top band.
final.arbiter_reason: The anchors make address the dominant axis: an impersonal answer scores 0 no matter how actionable it is, and actionability only separates 10 from 5, so a judge scoring this instruction is mainly reading second-person register. Mixed because handing the asker an executable next step does plausibly co-occur with genuine responsiveness to what they actually needed.

final.name: Structure-revealing representation
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether the chosen representation actually exposes the governing mathematical structure, direct evidence of insight and quality of the solution.

final.name: Concrete instantiation: specific numbers, examples, or visuals
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether concrete examples or visuals are used to make the abstract content tangible, a substantive pedagogical/explanatory quality rather than a surface marker.

final.name: Elementary-exercise versus research-register vocabulary
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores the register of the subject-matter vocabulary (elementary vs specialist) and instructs not to treat difficulty as merit, a topic/subject-matter marker.
final.upstream_parent: the kind of question the answer is attached to (a routine homework computation that one person wants closed versus a conceptual question that draws a crowd of answerers and spectators)

final.name: Prior-answer dependence
final.audit_justification: Scores visible wording referencing or contrasting with earlier answers/comments, explicitly excluding whether doing so is good, a textual fingerprint of the item's position in the thread.

final.name: Discovery narration paired with respect for the asker
final.audit_justification: Primarily rates narrative voice and interpersonal tone (companionable vs dismissive), a personality/register marker rather than the substance of the mathematics.
final.arbiter_reason: The two extremes hold narration constant (strong at both 10 and 0) and vary only stance, so by construction the criterion is a pure companionable-vs-dismissive tone dial with the explanatory content cancelled out. Not mixed: the upstream cause is author politeness, which the proposer's own exemplar (R03, enthusiastic narration over a wrong derivation) shows does not carry mathematical quality, while the dismissive pole can accompany a genuinely simpler correct solution.

final.name: Identifies and diagnoses the asker's specific error or confusion
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the answer pinpoints and fixes the asker's specific reasoning error, direct substantive evidence of responsiveness to the actual question.

final.name: Final line restates the exact target expression asked for
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the answer's conclusion explicitly delivers the exact form requested, direct evidence that the substance matches what was asked.

final.name: Era-specific conventions
final.audit_justification: Scores visible platform-era conventions and legacy markup habits, explicitly a vintage/temporal fingerprint with no plausible link to answer substance.

final.name: Hint that names the exact tool and its exact point of application
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a hint actually names a usable theorem/move that would let a competent reader proceed, direct evidence of the hint's substantive usefulness.

final.name: Confidence without hedging or self-deprecation
final.audit_justification: Scores definitiveness of tone versus hedging phrases, a register marker of confidence rather than a measure of whether the content is actually correct.
final.arbiter_reason: As written, a confidently asserted wrong answer scores 10 and a correct answer prefaced with 'I think' scores 0, so the instruction measures assertive register rather than whether the content is right. Mixed because hedging and explicit self-disclaimers ('this is not an answer to the question') often do track genuine incompleteness or uncertainty in the mathematics.

final.name: Substance in the first two lines versus long preamble
final.audit_justification: Scores how quickly the text reaches decisive content, a structural/organizational-presentation marker akin to formatting rather than the substance itself.
final.arbiter_reason: The discriminating axis is placement, not presence: the same decisive identity or counterexample scores 10 in sentence one and 0 in paragraph three, which makes this an organizational/presentation marker of the sort the protocol assigns to Track B. Mixed because an author who can state the verdict immediately plausibly has a crisper and more correct result to state.

final.name: Elementary question closed completely in a handful of lines
final.audit_justification: Requires the question to be elementary/narrow in scope as one of two conditions, a topic-scope marker, even though the other half concerns derivation completeness.
final.arbiter_reason: The composite is gated on the question being elementary or narrowly computational, so a fully rigorous, gapless answer to a hard question is forced to 0 and is scored identically to a bad answer on an easy one, making the criterion non-monotone in answer quality and dependent on a topic-scope marker. Mixed, and strongly so: the second half (carrying the derivation to a fully determined object with every step shown) is genuine craft and would route A if proposed unbundled from the scope gate.

final.name: Markup density
final.audit_justification: Scores density of markup, macros, colored notation, and diagrams while explicitly excluding whether the feature is good, a typographic/formatting marker.
final.upstream_parent: author's practice in the site's markup format

final.name: Proportionality of method
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the level of detail is proportionate while preserving the essential logic, direct evidence of the answer's substantive quality as an explanation.
